# Retain the actual published 1.25 source for current-build upgrade/recovery acceptance.
organized_baseline=root/'test-runtime/CajunWebPro-1.25.0-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.zip'
with urlopen('https://github.com/afterburn25/Cajun_Web/releases/download/v1.25.0/CajunWebPro-1.25.0-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.zip',timeout=60) as response:
    organized_bytes=response.read(15843209)
assert len(organized_bytes)==15843208
assert hashlib.sha256(organized_bytes).hexdigest()=='bebe9a62e36a7b1898baa95babd4f03b2e438a69b48ab42eedcda0f9dd443e39'
organized_baseline.write_bytes(organized_bytes)
organized_history=json.loads((root/'tools/legacy-release-files.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['1.25.0']
assert organized_history['archive_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(organized_bytes).hexdigest()
with zipfile.ZipFile(organized_baseline) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    names=z.namelist()
    assert len(names)==len(set(names))==len({name.casefold() for name in names})==2895
    assert set(names)==set(organized_history['files'])
    for item in z.infolist():
        path=PurePosixPath(item.filename)
        assert not item.is_dir() and not path.is_absolute() and path.as_posix()==item.filename
        assert not any(part in ('','.','..') for part in item.filename.split('/'))
        assert '\\' not in item.filename and ':' not in item.filename
        assert (item.external_attr>>16)&0o170000 != 0o120000
        assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(item)).hexdigest()==organized_history['files'][item.filename]
    z.extractall(root/'test-runtime/released-1.25.0')
print('PASS: immutable released 1.25.0 package checksum, exact member hashes, archive paths and extraction')

# Retain the complete original storefront journey before the owner setup continuation.
_storefront_checkout_before_plan_setup = run_browser


def run_browser(env, browser):
    original = _storefront_checkout_before_plan_setup(env, browser)
    if original.get('passed') is not True:
        raise AssertionError('Original storefront journey must complete first')
    from hosting_catalog_plan_setup_cases import CAPTURES as setup_captures, run_browser as setup_browser
    setup = setup_browser(env, browser)
    complete = (setup.get('passed') is True
                and tuple(row['name'] for row in setup.get('captures', [])) == setup_captures)
    env['check']('Installed guided plan setup completes after the original storefront journey', complete)
    if not complete:
        raise AssertionError('Installed guided plan setup did not complete')
    original['plan_setup'] = setup
    return original

    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']

    inputs:

        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice

        default: 'mariadb-10.11'

        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}

env:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}

          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):

        run: |

          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'

          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:

          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')

          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq

          "$PHP_BINARY" -m

def valid_port_context(workflow):
    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]
        if 'CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}' not in setup:return False
        if 'printf \'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\\n\' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"' not in setup:return False
    return True


def baseline_driver_predecessor(path, data, contract):
    delta = contract['release126_baseline_driver_delta'][path]
    a.require(set(delta) == {'predecessor_sha256', 'current_sha256', 'append', 'replacements'}, 'Unexpected baseline driver delta fields')
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['current_sha256'], 'Changed current baseline driver bytes')
    if delta['append']:
        suffix = delta['append'].encode()
        a.require(data.endswith(suffix) and data.count(suffix) == 1, 'Missing exact baseline preparation suffix')
        data = data[:-len(suffix)]
    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        a.require(set(edit) == {'before', 'after', 'count'} and type(edit['count']) is int and edit['count'] == 1, 'Invalid finite baseline driver edit')
        before, after = edit['before'].encode(), edit['after'].encode()
        a.require(before and after and data.count(after) == edit['count'], 'Missing exact baseline driver extension')
        data = data.replace(after, before)
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'] == contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path], 'Baseline driver predecessor changed')
    return data

        '"$PHP_BINARY" -n tests/hosting_checkout_document.php qa/hosting-checkout-document-minimal.json',

def hosting_upgrade_source_predecessor(data, delta):
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['current_sha256'], 'Changed hosting upgrade source')
    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        before, after = edit['before'].encode(), edit['after'].encode()
        a.require(set(edit) == {'before', 'after'} and before and after and data.count(after) == 1, 'Missing exact hosting upgrade source addition')
        data = data.replace(after, before, 1)
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'], 'Original upgrade source changed')
    return data

def catalog_storefront_http_predecessor(contract):

def retail_variants_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:

        run: |
          mkdir -p qa

          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:

          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)

          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"

          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m

<?php
/** Explicit local offer publication and requests. Existing agreement/payment/provider engines retain authority. */
declare(strict_types=1);
if (!defined('CWP_BOOT')) { http_response_code(404); exit; }
require_once __DIR__.'/catalog_offers_context.php';
require_once CWP_CODE_ROOT.'/database/migrations/hosting_catalog_migrate.php';

function hosting_catalog_publication(string $id): HostingCatalogPublication {
    hosting_catalog_guard();service_plans_id($id);
    $row=one('SELECT document_json,document_sha256 FROM '.table('hosting_catalog_publications').' WHERE id=?',[$id]);
    if (!$row) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Hosting offer unavailable.');
    $doc=HostingCatalogPublication::fromJson($row['document_json']);
    if ($doc->data()['id']!==$id || !hash_equals($doc->fingerprint(),$row['document_sha256'])) throw new RuntimeException('The original hosting offer needs recovery.');
    return $doc;
}
function hosting_catalog_request_document(string $id): HostingCatalogRequest {
    hosting_catalog_guard();service_plans_id($id);
    $row=one('SELECT document_json,document_sha256 FROM '.table('hosting_catalog_requests').' WHERE id=?',[$id]);
    if (!$row) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Hosting request unavailable.');
    $doc=HostingCatalogRequest::fromJson($row['document_json']);
    if ($doc->data()['id']!==$id || !hash_equals($doc->fingerprint(),$row['document_sha256'])) throw new RuntimeException('The original hosting request needs recovery.');
    return $doc;
}
/** Stable owner-review input excludes only publication creation time; no private details leave this hash. */
function hosting_catalog_review_hash(HostingCatalogPublication $publication): string {
    $data=$publication->data();unset($data['created_at']);
    return hash('sha256',service_plans_json($data));
}
function hosting_catalog_candidate(string $id,int $product,string $plan,array $actor,?array $checkoutPolicy=null): HostingCatalogPublication {
    hosting_catalog_guard();service_plans_id($id);
    $scope=hosting_catalog_read_scope([$product]);
    $source=hosting_catalog_sources($product,$plan,(int)$actor['id'],$scope);
    $source['context']['publication']=['id'=>$id,'sha256'=>null,'enabled'=>true];
    if ($checkoutPolicy!==null) {
        require_once __DIR__.'/catalog_checkout.php';
        if (!staff_can('payments.manage',$actor)) throw new RuntimeException('Current owner financial access is required for invoice checkout.');
        hosting_checkout_require();
        return HostingCatalogPublication::createCheckout($id,time(),$source['product'],$source['import'],$source['observation'],$source['plan'],$source['mapping_json'],$source['context'],hosting_checkout_policy($checkoutPolicy));
    }
    return HostingCatalogPublication::create($id,time(),$source['product'],$source['import'],$source['observation'],$source['plan'],$source['mapping_json'],$source['context']);
}
function hosting_catalog_preview(string $id,int $product,string $plan,?array $checkoutPolicy=null): array {
    if ($checkoutPolicy!==null) $checkoutPolicy=hosting_checkout_policy($checkoutPolicy);
    return recurring_billing_locked(function()use($id,$product,$plan,$checkoutPolicy):array {
        $actor=provider_catalog_import_owner();service_plans_owner();
        $candidate=hosting_catalog_candidate($id,$product,$plan,$actor,$checkoutPolicy);
        return ['review_sha256'=>hosting_catalog_review_hash($candidate),'offer'=>$candidate->historicalProjection()];
    });
}
function hosting_catalog_publish(string $id,int $product,string $plan,string $reviewHash,#[\SensitiveParameter] string $password,?array $checkoutPolicy=null): HostingCatalogPublication {
    service_plans_id($id);service_plans_id($plan);hosting_catalog_hash($reviewHash);

def check(name, condition):
    checks.append({'name': name, 'passed': bool(condition)})
    if not condition: raise AssertionError(name)


def deny(name, callback):
    try: callback()
    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError, zipfile.BadZipFile): check(name, True)
    else: check(name, False)


def blob(path, data=b'public synthetic bytes'):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); path.write_bytes(data)

        a.write(p.with_suffix('.manifest.json'), {'source_commit': ctx['ci_sha'], 'artifact': p.name,
                'sha256': a.digest(p), 'files': {member: hashlib.sha256(b'<?php /* synthetic public */').hexdigest()}})
        blob(p.with_suffix('.directories.txt'), b'public\n')
    a.write(dist / 'manifest.json', {'source_commit': ctx['ci_sha']})
    blob(dist / 'START-HERE.txt', b'Synthetic package')
    entries = sorted(dist.iterdir())

def named(path, passed=True):
    a.write(path, {'passed': passed, 'checks': [{'name': 'Synthetic exact check', 'passed': passed}]})


def synthetic_baseline():
    # Unit protocol bytes only. Actual upgrade acceptance uses the pinned published asset.
    stream = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(stream, 'w') as archive:
        for name, body in {'.htaccess': b'Deny public listing', 'includes/public.php': b'public synthetic bytes'}.items():
            archive.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 10, 12, 0, 0, 0)), body)
    return stream.getvalue()


def synthetic_baseline_126():
    # Deliberately different bytes from the retained 1.24 synthetic baseline.
    stream = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(stream, 'w') as archive:
        for name, body in {'.htaccess': b'Deny public listing', 'includes/public.php': b'public synthetic 1.25 bytes'}.items():
            archive.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 10, 12, 0, 0, 0)), body)
    return stream.getvalue()

    obj = a.verify_bundle(transfer, 'inputs', ctx, input_sha)

    a.validate_published_baseline_126(source, obj['files'])
    check('Both independently pinned published baselines validate in one sealed input',
          a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE != a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126 and synthetic_baseline() != synthetic_baseline_126())
    check('Additional baseline extends the public fixture set to exactly28 trees',
          len(a.FIXTURES) == 28 and a.VERSIONS[-2:] == ('1.24.0', '1.25.0'))
    check('Only the exact added published archive is admitted',
          a.input_allowed('test-runtime/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126))
    for name in ['test-runtime/CajunWebPro-1.26.0-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.zip',
                 'qa/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126,
                 'test-runtime/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126 + '/extra.php',
                 'test-runtime/private/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126]:
        check('Additional baseline cannot broaden the archive path allowlist ' + name, not a.input_allowed(name))
    prefix = 'test-runtime/released-1.25.0/'
    member = prefix + 'includes/public.php'
    for title, mutation in [
        ('missing', lambda f: f.pop(member)),
        ('extra', lambda f: f.update({prefix + 'extra.php': f[member]})),
        ('changed digest', lambda f: f[member].update(sha256='0' * 64)),
        ('changed size', lambda f: f[member].update(size=f[member]['size'] + 1)),
        ('traversal', lambda f: f.update({prefix + '../outside': f.pop(member)})),
    ]:
        facts = copy.deepcopy(obj['files']); mutation(facts)
        deny('Added baseline refuses ' + title + ' member evidence', lambda f=facts: a.validate_published_baseline_126(source, f))
    archive = source / 'test-runtime' / a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126
    raw = archive.read_bytes()
    try:
        archive.write_bytes(synthetic_baseline())
        deny('Original1.24 raw archive cannot impersonate the added1.25 baseline', lambda: a.validate_published_baseline_126(source, obj['files']))
        archive.write_bytes(raw[:-1] + bytes([raw[-1] ^ 1]))
        deny('Added baseline refuses mutated original ZIP bytes', lambda: a.validate_published_baseline_126(source, obj['files']))
        archive.unlink()
        deny('Added baseline cannot fall back when its raw original ZIP is absent', lambda: a.validate_published_baseline_126(source, obj['files']))
    finally:
        archive.write_bytes(raw)
    # Correctly re-sealed envelopes still cannot omit either original baseline or new fixture tree.
    for index, omitted in enumerate(['test-runtime/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE,
                                     'test-runtime/' + a.PUBLISHED_BASELINE_126, prefix]):
        facts = {n: f for n, f in obj['files'].items() if n != omitted and not n.startswith(omitted if omitted.endswith('/') else omitted + '/')}
        folder = tmp / ('baseline-omission-' + str(index)); folder.mkdir()
        envelope = dict(obj, files=facts, archive=a.pack(source, facts, folder / 'inputs.zip'))
        a.write(folder / 'inputs.json', envelope)
        deny('Re-sealed input still requires original baseline family ' + omitted,

    # Wrong new fixture bytes with coherent outer hashes must fail the immutable inner baseline.
    changed = tmp / 'baseline-member-changed'; shutil.copytree(source, changed)
    blob(changed / member, b'wrong but coherently sealed fixture member')
    facts = copy.deepcopy(obj['files']); facts[member] = a.file_facts(changed / member)
    folder = tmp / 'baseline-coherent-envelope'; folder.mkdir()
    envelope = dict(obj, files=facts, archive=a.pack(changed, facts, folder / 'inputs.zip'))
    a.write(folder / 'inputs.json', envelope)
    deny('Coherent outer input cannot replace an original1.25 member',

def outcomes(lane): return {k: 'success' for k in a.STEP_KEYS[lane]}


def valid_port_context(workflow):
    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]
        if 'CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}' not in setup:return False
        if 'printf \'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\\n\' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"' not in setup:return False
    return True


def baseline_driver_predecessor(path, data, contract):
    delta = contract['release126_baseline_driver_delta'][path]
    a.require(set(delta) == {'predecessor_sha256', 'current_sha256', 'append', 'replacements'}, 'Unexpected baseline driver delta fields')
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['current_sha256'], 'Changed current baseline driver bytes')
    if delta['append']:
        suffix = delta['append'].encode()
        a.require(data.endswith(suffix) and data.count(suffix) == 1, 'Missing exact baseline preparation suffix')
        data = data[:-len(suffix)]
    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        a.require(set(edit) == {'before', 'after', 'count'} and type(edit['count']) is int and edit['count'] == 1, 'Invalid finite baseline driver edit')
        before, after = edit['before'].encode(), edit['after'].encode()
        a.require(before and after and data.count(after) == edit['count'], 'Missing exact baseline driver extension')
        data = data.replace(after, before)
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'] == contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path], 'Baseline driver predecessor changed')
    return data

        '"$PHP_BINARY" -n tests/hosting_checkout_document.php qa/hosting-checkout-document-minimal.json',
        '"$PHP_BINARY" tests/service-plans/checkout_documents.php > qa/hosting-checkout-subscription-default.json',

    return original


def hosting_checkout_workflow_predecessor(workflow, checkout):
    a.require(len(checkout['workflow_delta']) == 2, 'Two exact checkout workflow insertions required')
    for edit in reversed(checkout['workflow_delta']):
        a.require(set(edit) == {'before', 'after'} and edit['before'] and edit['after'] and workflow.count(edit['after']) == 1, 'Exact checkout workflow insertion missing')
        workflow = workflow.replace(edit['after'], edit['before'], 1)
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(workflow.encode()).hexdigest() == checkout['predecessor_workflow_sha256'], 'Full workflow changed outside checkout additions')
    return workflow


def hosting_checkout_report_predecessor(reports, checkout):
    expected = ['hosting-checkout-' + name + '.json' for name in (
        'document-default', 'document-minimal', 'subscription-default', 'subscription-minimal',
        'billing-default', 'billing-minimal', 'views-default', 'views-minimal', 'native-results', 'http-guards', 'http-results')]
    a.require(checkout['reports'] == expected, 'Eleven exact checkout report names required')
    original = copy.deepcopy(reports)
    for lane, count in [('browser', 196), ('final', 247)]:
        current = reports[lane]; prior = [n for n in current if n not in expected]

        a.require(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(prior, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest() == checkout['predecessor_reports_sha256'][lane], 'Original report sequence changed')

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result


def subdomain_add_predecessor(root):
    current=a.load(root/'tools/acceptance-contract.json');launch=current['subdomain_add']
    contract=copy.deepcopy(current);del contract['subdomain_add']
    commands=launch['native_additions'];position=contract['native_commands'].index(launch['native_after'])+1
    if contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]!=commands or any(contract['native_commands'].count(c)!=1 for c in commands):
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add native recipe changed')
    del contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]
    for path,old_hash in launch['predecessor_test_pins'].items():contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path]=old_hash
    if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(contract,indent=2).encode()+b'\n').hexdigest()!=launch['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor contract changed')
    workflow=subdomain_add_inverse((root/'.github/workflows/application-tests.yml').read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'),launch['workflow_delta']).decode()
    return contract,workflow,launch


def subdomain_add_predecessor_source(root,path,launch):
    data=root.joinpath(path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    delta=launch['source_deltas'].get(path)
    return subdomain_add_inverse(data,delta) if delta else data


def subdomain_driver_predecessor(data):
    lines=data.decode().split('\n')
    start=lines.index("    contract,workflow,subdomain=subdomain_add_predecessor(ROOT)")
    native=next(i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith('    native=workflow.split('))
    call=lines.index("    subdomain_add_checks(tmp,subdomain)")
    frag=lines.index("    check('Retail variants retain all189 native commands and add five exact producers',")
    return ('\n'.join(lines[:start]+lines[native:call]+lines[frag-1:])+'\n').encode()

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

def retail_variants_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor changed')
    return result


def retail_variants_current(current=None, registry=None):
    if current is None:

    for path, digest in section['source_sha256'].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants current source changed: '+path)
    prior = copy.deepcopy(current)
    del prior['catalog_retail_variants']
    additions = section['native_additions']
    position = prior['native_commands'].index(section['native_after'])+1
    if prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)] != additions or any(prior['native_commands'].count(c) != 1 for c in additions):
        raise ValueError('Retail variants native recipe changed')
    del prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)]
    for pin in section['repins']:
        cursor = prior
        for key in pin['keys'][:-1]:
            cursor = cursor[key]
        key = pin['keys'][-1]
        if cursor[key] != pin['after']:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants current serialized pin changed')
        cursor[key] = pin['before']
    dump = lambda value: json.dumps(value, indent=2).encode()+b'\n'
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(prior)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor contract changed')
    old_reports = copy.deepcopy(registry)
    for phase in ('browser', 'final'):
        if any(old_reports[phase].count(name) != 1 for name in section['reports']):
            raise ValueError('Retail variants report missing or duplicated')
        old_reports[phase] = [name for name in old_reports[phase] if name not in section['reports']]
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(old_reports)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_reports_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor reports changed')
    historical = {'tools/acceptance-contract.json': dump(prior), 'tools/acceptance-reports.json': dump(old_reports)}
    for path, delta in section['source_deltas'].items():
        historical[path] = retail_variants_inverse((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'), delta)

changes.after:
name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane build
      - name: Offline transfer, provenance and failure regressions
        id: helpers
        run: python3 tests/acceptance_artifacts_test.py --report qa/parallel-helper-tests.json
      - name: Exact source, installer inventory and one package build
        id: build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 tools/build.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" | tee qa/build-results.txt
          python3 tests/build_guards.py
      - name: Prepare only pristine public historical fixtures
        id: fixtures
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 tests/prepare_legacy.py | tee qa/legacy-preparation.txt
      - name: Seal exact build and public inputs
        id: inputs
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py pack-inputs
      - name: Upload immutable build inputs
        id: input_upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.zip
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Verify shipping source after this job, including failure
        if: always()
        id: mutation
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py guard
      - name: Preserve this job's exact evidence partition
        if: always()
        id: seal
        env:
          CWP_STEP_OUTCOMES: >-
            {"setup": "${{ steps.setup.outcome }}", "helpers": "${{ steps.helpers.outcome }}", "build": "${{ steps.build.outcome }}", "fixtures": "${{ steps.fixtures.outcome }}", "inputs": "${{ steps.inputs.outcome }}", "mutation": "${{ steps.mutation.outcome }}"}
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py seal --lane build
      - name: Upload immutable evidence partition
        if: always() && steps.seal.outcome == 'success'
        id: partition_upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-partition-build-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/partition/partition.zip
            .acceptance/partition/partition.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
  native-and-browser:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Original run38909577278 exhausted105m; run39024070818 later exhausted180m
    # during the final scheduler flow, with requests completing until the job cap.
    # Preserve every assertion, request/browser/provider limit and native-to-browser state.
    timeout-minutes: 240
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      checkpoint_id: ${{ steps.checkpoint_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      checkpoint_digest: ${{ steps.checkpoint_upload.outputs.artifact-digest }}
    services:
      mariadb:
        image: ${{ inputs.database == 'mysql-8.4' && 'mysql:8.4' || 'mariadb:10.11' }}
        env:
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: isolated-ci-root-only
          MARIADB_DATABASE: cwp_test
          MARIADB_USER: cwp_test
          MARIADB_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: isolated-ci-root-only
          MYSQL_DATABASE: cwp_test
          MYSQL_USER: cwp_test
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
        ports: ['3306']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping --silent"
          --health-interval=5s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=20
    env:
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_HOST: 127.0.0.1
      CWP_TEST_USER: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
      CWP_INPUT_SHA256: ${{ needs.build.outputs.input_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        env:
          CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          printf 'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\n' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          export CWP_TEST_PORT="$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT"
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y libfaketime "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          if [ "$CWP_DATABASE" = "mysql-8.4" ]; then
            docker exec -e MYSQL_PWD=isolated-ci-root-only ${{ job.services.mariadb.id }} mysql -uroot -e 'SET GLOBAL log_bin_trust_function_creators=1'
          fi
          python3 -m venv .ci-venv
          .ci-venv/bin/pip install --disable-pip-version-check requests beautifulsoup4 cryptography==50.0.1 playwright
          .ci-venv/bin/python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane native

          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:

              key_path = Path(signed_by)

name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR

          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane build

        id: helpers
        run: python3 tests/acceptance_artifacts_test.py --report qa/parallel-helper-tests.json
      - name: Exact source, installer inventory and one package build
        id: build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 tools/build.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" | tee qa/build-results.txt
          python3 tests/build_guards.py
      - name: Prepare only pristine public historical fixtures
        id: fixtures
        run: |

      - name: Seal exact build and public inputs
        id: inputs
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py pack-inputs
      - name: Upload immutable build inputs
        id: input_upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.zip
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Verify shipping source after this job, including failure
        if: always()
        id: mutation
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py guard
      - name: Preserve this job's exact evidence partition

            {"setup": "${{ steps.setup.outcome }}", "helpers": "${{ steps.helpers.outcome }}", "build": "${{ steps.build.outcome }}", "fixtures": "${{ steps.fixtures.outcome }}", "inputs": "${{ steps.inputs.outcome }}", "mutation": "${{ steps.mutation.outcome }}"}

      - name: Upload immutable evidence partition

          name: application-partition-build-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/partition/partition.zip

          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

    needs: build
    if: ${{ !inputs.checkpoint_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
    env:
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_INPUT_SHA256: ${{ needs.build.outputs.input_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')

def valid_port_context(workflow):
    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]
        if 'CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}' not in setup:return False
        if 'printf \'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\\n\' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"' not in setup:return False
    return True

    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):

    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'] == contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path], 'Baseline driver predecessor changed')

def retail_variants_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor changed')
    return result

def valid_port_context(workflow):
    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]
        if 'CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}' not in setup:return False
        if 'printf \'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\\n\' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"' not in setup:return False
    return True

    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):

    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'] == contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path], 'Baseline driver predecessor changed')

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

def native_labels(source):
    """Exact literal native producer labels, including its closed two-key contact loop."""
    text = source
    for line in source.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith("foreach(['contact_id','contact_auth'] as $key){"):
            body = line.split('){', 1)[1].rsplit('}', 1)[0]
            text = text.replace(line, '\n'.join(body.replace('$key', repr(key)) for key in ('contact_id', 'contact_auth')))
    text = re.sub(r"'\.'(contact_id|contact_auth)'", r"\1'", text)
    labels = re.findall(r"\bhcc_(?:ok|deny)\('([^']*)'", text)
    require(len(labels) == 79 and len(labels) == len(set(labels)), 'Exact corrected native producer required')
    return labels

        result = {}

    report = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs)

    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result
