name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane build
      - name: Offline transfer, provenance and failure regressions
        id: helpers
        run: python3 tests/acceptance_artifacts_test.py --report qa/parallel-helper-tests.json
      - name: Exact source, installer inventory and one package build
        id: build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 tools/build.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" | tee qa/build-results.txt
          python3 tests/build_guards.py
      - name: Prepare only pristine public historical fixtures
        id: fixtures
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 tests/prepare_legacy.py | tee qa/legacy-preparation.txt
      - name: Seal exact build and public inputs
        id: inputs
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py pack-inputs
      - name: Upload immutable build inputs
        id: input_upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.zip
            .acceptance/inputs/inputs.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Verify shipping source after this job, including failure
        if: always()
        id: mutation
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py guard
      - name: Preserve this job's exact evidence partition
        if: always()
        id: seal
        env:
          CWP_STEP_OUTCOMES: >-
            {"setup": "${{ steps.setup.outcome }}", "helpers": "${{ steps.helpers.outcome }}", "build": "${{ steps.build.outcome }}", "fixtures": "${{ steps.fixtures.outcome }}", "inputs": "${{ steps.inputs.outcome }}", "mutation": "${{ steps.mutation.outcome }}"}
        run: python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py seal --lane build
      - name: Upload immutable evidence partition
        if: always() && steps.seal.outcome == 'success'
        id: partition_upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-partition-build-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            .acceptance/partition/partition.zip
            .acceptance/partition/partition.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

          persist-credentials: false

        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')

          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 -m venv .ci-venv

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

    check('Retail variants retain all231 native commands and add five exact producers',
          len(current['native_commands']) == 236 and len(section['native_additions']) == 5
          and [c for c in current['native_commands'] if c not in section['native_additions']] == prior['native_commands'])
    check('Retail variants require six unique report producers and no new captures',
          len(section['reports']) == len(set(section['reports'])) == 6 and section['screenshots'] == [])
    workflow = (ROOT/'.github/workflows/application-tests.yml').read_text()
    previous = historical['.github/workflows/application-tests.yml'].decode()
    inserted = ''.join('          '+command+'\n' for command in section['native_additions'])
    browser = '          '+section['browser_command']+'\n'
    check('Retail variants workflow changes only the five native recipes and local browser command',
          workflow.count(inserted) == 1 and workflow.count(browser) == 1
          and workflow.replace(inserted, '', 1).replace(browser, '', 1) == previous)
    check('Retail variant browser uses selected PHP after existing Python browser setup',
          section['browser_command'] == '.ci-venv/bin/python -B tests/hosting_catalog_variants_browser.py --php "$PHP_BINARY" --report qa/hosting-catalog-variants-browser-results.json'
          and workflow.index('.ci-venv/bin/pip install') < workflow.index(section['browser_command']))
    check('Retail variant native preserves explicit Linux isolated opt-in and mapped port selection',
          section['native_additions'][-1] == 'CWP_TEST_HOSTING_VARIANTS=1 "$PHP_BINARY" tests/hosting_catalog_variants_native.php' and valid_port_context(workflow))
    for path, digest in section['source_sha256'].items():
        check('Retail variants bind current source '+path,
              hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() == digest)
    for path, delta in section['source_deltas'].items():
        check('Retail variants preserve complete parent source '+path,
              hashlib.sha256(historical[path]).hexdigest() == delta['before_sha256'])
        deny('Retail variants refuse modified current source '+path,
             lambda path=path, delta=delta: retail_variants_inverse((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')+b'\n', delta))
    wrong = copy.deepcopy(current)
    wrong['native_commands'].pop(0)
    deny('Retail variants refuse a removed original command', lambda: retail_variants_current(wrong, registry))
    wrong = copy.deepcopy(current)
    wrong['native_commands'][0] += ' changed'
    deny('Retail variants refuse an altered original command', lambda: retail_variants_current(wrong, registry))
    wrong = copy.deepcopy(current)
    first = next(iter(section['source_deltas']))
    wrong['catalog_retail_variants']['source_deltas'][first]['before_sha256'] = '0'*64
    deny('Retail variants refuse a substituted predecessor source', lambda: retail_variants_current(wrong, registry))
    wrong = copy.deepcopy(registry)
    wrong['final'].remove(next(n for n in wrong['final'] if n not in section['reports']))
    deny('Retail variants refuse removing an original report', lambda: retail_variants_current(current, wrong))
    for pin in section['repins']:
        wrong = copy.deepcopy(current)
        cursor = wrong
        for key in pin['keys'][:-1]:
            cursor = cursor[key]
        cursor[pin['keys'][-1]] = pin['before']
        try:
            retail_variants_current(wrong, registry)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Stale retail variant source pin passed')
    check('Retail variants refuse every stale serialized current pin', True)
    for phase, expected in [('browser', 256), ('final', 313)]:
        check('Retail variants preserve exact original '+phase+' reports',
              len(registry[phase]) == len(set(registry[phase])) == expected
              and [n for n in registry[phase] if n not in section['reports']] == json.loads(historical['tools/acceptance-reports.json'])[phase])
    root = tmp/'retail-variants-artifacts'
    source = root/'source'
    ctx = context()
    fixtures(source, ctx)
    incoming = root/'partitions'
    bindings = {}
    jobs = {}
    input_sha = '7'*64
    for index, lane in enumerate(a.LANES):
        job = root/('job-'+lane)
        job.mkdir(parents=True)
        jobs[lane] = job
        if lane == 'build':
            shutil.copytree(source/'dist', job/'dist')
            shutil.copytree(source/'qa', job/'qa')
        elif lane == 'native-browser':
            for name in registry['browser']:
                if name not in a.BUILD_QA:
                    named(job/'qa'/name)
        else:
            for name in registry['final']:
                if name not in registry['browser'] and a.evidence_allowed('qa/'+name, lane):
                    named(job/'qa'/name)
        digest = a.seal(job, ctx, incoming/lane, lane, outcomes(lane), input_sha)
        bindings[lane] = {'result':'success','artifact_id':str(index+81),'sha256':digest,**({'input_sha256':input_sha} if lane == 'build' else {}),**({'checkpoint_id':'89','checkpoint_digest':'8'*64} if lane == 'native-browser' else {})}
    seq = 0
    def combine():
        nonlocal seq
        seq += 1
        return a.aggregate(root/('combined-'+str(seq)), ctx, incoming, bindings, registry)
    def reseal():
        job = jobs['native-browser']
        for path in (job/'.acceptance/checkpoint', incoming/'native-browser'):
            if path.exists():
                assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
                shutil.rmtree(path)
        bindings['native-browser']['sha256'] = a.seal(job, ctx, incoming/'native-browser', 'native-browser', outcomes('native-browser'), input_sha)
    result = combine()
    check('Retail variants aggregate requires all290 current reports', result['complete'] is True and set(result['reports']) == set(registry['final']))
    for name in section['reports']:
        path = jobs['native-browser']/'qa'/name
        path.unlink()
        reseal()
        result = combine()
        check('Retail variants missing report refuses '+name, result['complete'] is False and 'Missing reports: '+name in result['errors'])
        named(path, False)
        reseal()
        result = combine()
        check('Retail variants failed report refuses '+name, result['complete'] is False and result['reports'][name]['passed'] is False)
        named(path)
        check('Retail variants report stays in native-browser '+name,
              a.evidence_allowed('qa/'+name, 'native-browser') and not any(a.evidence_allowed('qa/'+name, lane) for lane in ('build', 'apache', 'recovery')))
    named(jobs['native-browser']/'qa/retail-variants-unexpected-results.json')
    reseal()
    result = combine()
    check('Retail variants unexpected report refuses', result['complete'] is False and 'Unexpected reports: retail-variants-unexpected-results.json' in result['errors'])
    for path in ('test-runtime/hosting-catalog-variants-private/provider-master.key', 'qa/hosting-catalog-variants-private/provider-master.key'):
        deny('Retail variant private fixture file refuses '+path,
             lambda path=path: a.evidence_allowed(path, 'native-browser'))

def billing_selector_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Billing selector inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector predecessor changed')
    return result


def billing_selector_current(current=None, registry=None):
    if current is None:
        current = a.load(ROOT/'tools/acceptance-contract.json')
    if registry is None:
        registry = a.load(ROOT/'tools/acceptance-reports.json')
    section = current['hosting_billing_selector']
    for path, digest in section['source_sha256'].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError('Billing selector current source changed: '+path)
    prior = copy.deepcopy(current)
    del prior['hosting_billing_selector']
    additions = section['native_additions']
    position = prior['native_commands'].index(section['native_after'])+1
    if prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)] != additions or any(prior['native_commands'].count(c) != 1 for c in additions):
        raise ValueError('Billing selector native recipe changed')
    del prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)]
    for pin in section['repins']:
        cursor = prior
        for key in pin['keys'][:-1]:
            cursor = cursor[key]
        key = pin['keys'][-1]
        if cursor[key] != pin['after']:
            raise ValueError('Billing selector current serialized pin changed')
        cursor[key] = pin['before']
    dump = lambda value: json.dumps(value, indent=2).encode()+b'\n'
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(prior)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector predecessor contract changed')
    old_reports = copy.deepcopy(registry)
    for phase in ('browser', 'final'):
        if any(old_reports[phase].count(name) != 1 for name in section['reports']):
            raise ValueError('Billing selector report missing or duplicated')
        old_reports[phase] = [name for name in old_reports[phase] if name not in section['reports']]
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(old_reports)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_reports_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector predecessor reports changed')
    historical = {'tools/acceptance-contract.json': dump(prior), 'tools/acceptance-reports.json': dump(old_reports)}
    for path, delta in section['source_deltas'].items():
        historical[path] = billing_selector_inverse((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'), delta)
    return current, registry, section, historical

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

        raise ValueError('Subdomain add native recipe changed')
    del contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]
    for path,old_hash in launch['predecessor_test_pins'].items():contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path]=old_hash

def retail_variants_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:

    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Retail variants inverse range changed')

    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Retail variants predecessor changed')
    return result

def installed_billing_options_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Installed billing options current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Installed billing options inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Installed billing options predecessor changed')
    return result


def installed_billing_options_current(current=None, registry=None):
    if current is None:
        current = a.load(ROOT/'tools/acceptance-contract.json')

        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError('Installed billing options current source changed: '+path)
    prior = copy.deepcopy(current)
    del prior['hosting_billing_options']
    additions = section['native_additions']
    position = prior['native_commands'].index(section['native_after'])+1
    if prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)] != additions or any(prior['native_commands'].count(c) != 1 for c in additions):
        raise ValueError('Installed billing options native recipe changed')
    del prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)]
    for pin in section['repins']:
        cursor = prior
        for key in pin['keys'][:-1]:
            cursor = cursor[key]
        key = pin['keys'][-1]
        if cursor[key] != pin['after']:
            raise ValueError('Installed billing options current serialized pin changed')
        cursor[key] = pin['before']
    dump = lambda value: json.dumps(value, indent=2).encode()+b'\n'
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(prior)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Installed billing options predecessor contract changed')
    old_reports = copy.deepcopy(registry)
    for phase in ('browser', 'final'):
        if any(old_reports[phase].count(name) != 1 for name in section['reports']):
            raise ValueError('Installed billing options report missing or duplicated')
        old_reports[phase] = [name for name in old_reports[phase] if name not in section['reports']]
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(old_reports)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_reports_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Installed billing options predecessor reports changed')
    historical = {'tools/acceptance-contract.json': dump(prior), 'tools/acceptance-reports.json': dump(old_reports)}
    for path, delta in section['source_deltas'].items():
        historical[path] = installed_billing_options_inverse((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'), delta)
    return current, registry, section, historical

name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reclaim unused hosted toolchain disk
        run: |
          # Hosted runners preinstall ~14GB of unrelated toolchains; the suite's
          # MariaDB plus release fixtures filled the disk (errno=28) on past runs.
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY" /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc /usr/local/share/boost /opt/android || true
          sudo docker image prune --all --force || true
          df -h /
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
    env:
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_INPUT_SHA256: ${{ needs.build.outputs.input_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reclaim unused hosted toolchain disk
        run: |
          # Hosted runners preinstall ~14GB of unrelated toolchains; the suite's
          # MariaDB plus release fixtures filled the disk (errno=28) on past runs.
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY" /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc /usr/local/share/boost /opt/android || true
          sudo docker image prune --all --force || true
          df -h /
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 -m venv .ci-venv
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane recovery
      - name: Download this attempt's immutable build input

        if: needs.build.outputs.inputs_id != ''

      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        env:
          CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          printf 'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\n' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          export CWP_TEST_PORT="$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT"
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq

          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"

          "$PHP_BINARY" -v

          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:

              key_path = Path(signed_by)

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

def billing_selector_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Billing selector inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Billing selector predecessor changed')
    return result

def client_https_requests_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests inverse range changed')

    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

def subdomain_browser_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser current source mismatch')
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after']) != 1: raise ValueError('Subdomain browser ambiguous inverse')
        text = text.replace(item['after'], item['before'], 1)
    result = text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain browser predecessor mismatch')
    return result

def client_https_requests_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests current source changed')
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    for change in reversed(delta['changes']):
        start, end = change['after_start'], change['after_end']
        if ''.join(lines[start:end]) != change['after']:
            raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests inverse range changed')
        lines[start:end] = change['before'].splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = ''.join(lines).encode()
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests predecessor changed')
    return result


def client_https_requests_current():
    current = a.load(ROOT/'tools/acceptance-contract.json'); section = current['client_https_requests']

    additions = section['native_additions']; position = prior['native_commands'].index(section['native_after'])+1
    if prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)] != additions or any(prior['native_commands'].count(c) != 1 for c in additions):
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests native recipe changed')
    del prior['native_commands'][position:position+len(additions)]
    for pin in section['repins']:
        cursor = prior
        for key in pin['keys'][:-1]: cursor = cursor[key]

        if cursor[key] != pin['after']: raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests current pin changed')
        cursor[key] = pin['before']
    dump = lambda value: json.dumps(value, indent=2).encode()+b'\n'
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(prior)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests predecessor contract changed')
    old_reports = copy.deepcopy(registry)
    for phase in ('browser', 'final'):
        if any(old_reports[phase].count(name) != 1 for name in section['reports']): raise ValueError('Client HTTPS requests report missing or duplicated')
        old_reports[phase] = [name for name in old_reports[phase] if name not in section['reports']]
    if hashlib.sha256(dump(old_reports)).hexdigest() != section['predecessor_reports_sha256']:

    historical = {'tools/acceptance-contract.json': dump(prior), 'tools/acceptance-reports.json': dump(old_reports)}
    for path, delta in section['source_deltas'].items():
        historical[path] = client_https_requests_inverse((ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'), delta)

        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')

          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"

          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m

              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')

              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring" apache2-bin "libapache2-mod-php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262

        if: always() && needs.apache.outputs.artifact_id != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.apache.outputs.artifact_id }}

          path: .acceptance/incoming/apache

        if: always()
        env:

          mkdir -p qa
          python3 tools/acceptance_artifacts.py aggregate
      - name: Preserve final or deliberately limited checkpoint evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'acceptance' }}-${{ github.sha }}${{ github.run_attempt != 1 && format('-attempt-{0}', github.run_attempt) || '' }}
          path: |
            qa/

name: Application acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/finish-1.1.0, codex/release-1.1.0, codex/admin-accounts, codex/client-support, codex/service-catalog, codex/payment-foundation, codex/sandbox-attempts, codex/sandbox-webhooks, codex/invoice-ledger, codex/client-deliveries, codex/workspace-activity, codex/portfolio-browsing, codex/priority-directory-refactor, codex/twentyi-domain-search, codex/twentyi-recurring-recovery, codex/twentyi-catalog-controls, codex/twentyi-vps-controls, codex/twentyi-catalog-readiness, codex/twentyi-cloud-confirmation, codex/twentyi-forwarding-requests, codex/twentyi-scheduled-refresh, codex/twentyi-cloud-providers, codex/twentyi-domain-contracts, codex/twentyi-package-php-version, codex/twentyi-nameserver-changes, codex/twentyi-client-nameserver-requests, 'devin/non20i-*', 'devin/full-site-integration', codex/twentyi-hosting-purchase-inbox, codex/twentyi-purchase-inbox-browser]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, codex/twentyi-fulfillment, codex/twentyi-service-orders, codex/twentyi-client-domain-search, codex/twentyi-mailbox-controls]
    paths: ['site/**', 'foundation/**', 'tests/**', 'tools/**', '.github/workflows/application-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      php_version:
        description: 'Complete acceptance PHP runtime; 8.3 retains the distro baseline'
        type: choice
        options: ['8.3', '8.2', '8.4']
        default: '8.3'
      database:
        description: 'Complete acceptance database server'
        type: choice
        options: ['mariadb-10.11', 'mysql-8.4']
        default: 'mariadb-10.11'
      checkpoint_only:
        description: 'Build, native database and browser checkpoint only; not release acceptance'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  # Preserve every running acceptance, including repeated invocations of one source.
  group: application-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ inputs.checkpoint_only && 'checkpoint' || 'full' }}-${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}-${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ inputs.php_version || '8.3' }}
  CWP_DATABASE: ${{ inputs.database || 'mariadb-10.11' }}
  CWP_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
      inputs_id: ${{ steps.input_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      input_sha256: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'

        run: |
          mkdir -p qa

          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'

          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:

              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')

          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq

    needs: build
    if: ${{ !inputs.checkpoint_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.partition_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.sha256 }}
    env:
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_INPUT_SHA256: ${{ needs.build.outputs.input_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result


def subdomain_add_predecessor(root):
    current=a.load(root/'tools/acceptance-contract.json');launch=current['subdomain_add']
    contract=copy.deepcopy(current);del contract['subdomain_add']
    commands=launch['native_additions'];position=contract['native_commands'].index(launch['native_after'])+1
    if contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]!=commands or any(contract['native_commands'].count(c)!=1 for c in commands):
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add native recipe changed')
    del contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]
    for path,old_hash in launch['predecessor_test_pins'].items():contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path]=old_hash
    if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(contract,indent=2).encode()+b'\n').hexdigest()!=launch['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor contract changed')
    workflow=subdomain_add_inverse((root/'.github/workflows/application-tests.yml').read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'),launch['workflow_delta']).decode()
    return contract,workflow,launch


def subdomain_add_predecessor_source(root,path,launch):
    data=root.joinpath(path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    delta=launch['source_deltas'].get(path)
    return subdomain_add_inverse(data,delta) if delta else data


def subdomain_driver_predecessor(data):
    lines=data.decode().split('\n')
    start=lines.index("    contract,workflow,subdomain=subdomain_add_predecessor(ROOT)")
    native=next(i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith('    native=workflow.split('))
    call=lines.index("    subdomain_add_checks(tmp,subdomain)")
    frag=lines.index("    check('Retail variants retain all189 native commands and add five exact producers',")
    return ('\n'.join(lines[:start]+lines[native:call]+lines[frag-1:])+'\n').encode()

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result

        raise ValueError('Subdomain add native recipe changed')
    del contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]
    for path,old_hash in launch['predecessor_test_pins'].items():contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path]=old_hash

          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare isolated runtime and evidence directory
        id: setup
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common

            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          python3 -m venv .ci-venv

def valid_port_context(workflow):
    for job in ('native-and-browser', 'apache'):
        match=re.search(r'^  '+job+r':\n(.*?)(?=^  [a-z][a-z-]*:|\Z)',workflow,re.M|re.S)
        if not match:return False
        body=match.group(1)
        env=body.split('    env:\n',1)[1].split('    steps:\n',1)[0]
        if 'job.services' in env or 'CWP_TEST_PORT:' in env:return False
        setup=body.split('        id: setup\n',1)[1].split('      - name:',1)[0]
        if 'CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.mariadb.ports[3306] }}' not in setup:return False
        if 'printf \'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\\n\' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"' not in setup:return False
    return True


def baseline_driver_predecessor(path, data, contract):
    delta = contract['release126_baseline_driver_delta'][path]
    a.require(set(delta) == {'predecessor_sha256', 'current_sha256', 'append', 'replacements'}, 'Unexpected baseline driver delta fields')
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['current_sha256'], 'Changed current baseline driver bytes')
    if delta['append']:
        suffix = delta['append'].encode()
        a.require(data.endswith(suffix) and data.count(suffix) == 1, 'Missing exact baseline preparation suffix')

    for edit in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        a.require(set(edit) == {'before', 'after', 'count'} and type(edit['count']) is int and edit['count'] == 1, 'Invalid finite baseline driver edit')
        before, after = edit['before'].encode(), edit['after'].encode()
        a.require(before and after and data.count(after) == edit['count'], 'Missing exact baseline driver extension')
        data = data.replace(after, before)
    a.require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == delta['predecessor_sha256'] == contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path], 'Baseline driver predecessor changed')
    return data

def hosting_recipe_predecessor(commands, contract):

def hosting_workflow_predecessor(workflow, hosting):
    for edit in reversed(hosting['workflow_delta']):

    a.require(hashlib.sha256(workflow.encode()).hexdigest() == hosting['predecessor_workflow_sha256'], 'Original full workflow changed outside finite hosting additions')
    return workflow

def subdomain_add_inverse(data, delta):
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=delta['after_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add current source changed')
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    for item in reversed(delta['replacements']):
        if text.count(item['after'])!=1:raise ValueError('Subdomain add inverse is not unique')
        text=text.replace(item['after'],item['before'],1)
    result=text.encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()!=delta['before_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor changed')
    return result


def subdomain_add_predecessor(root):
    current=a.load(root/'tools/acceptance-contract.json');launch=current['subdomain_add']
    contract=copy.deepcopy(current);del contract['subdomain_add']
    commands=launch['native_additions'];position=contract['native_commands'].index(launch['native_after'])+1
    if contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]!=commands or any(contract['native_commands'].count(c)!=1 for c in commands):
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add native recipe changed')
    del contract['native_commands'][position:position+7]
    for path,old_hash in launch['predecessor_test_pins'].items():contract['unchanged_test_sha256'][path]=old_hash
    if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(contract,indent=2).encode()+b'\n').hexdigest()!=launch['predecessor_contract_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Subdomain add predecessor contract changed')
    workflow=subdomain_add_inverse((root/'.github/workflows/application-tests.yml').read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'),launch['workflow_delta']).decode()
    return contract,workflow,launch


def subdomain_add_predecessor_source(root,path,launch):
    data=root.joinpath(path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    delta=launch['source_deltas'].get(path)
    return subdomain_add_inverse(data,delta) if delta else data


def subdomain_driver_predecessor(data):
    lines=data.decode().split('\n')
    start=lines.index("    contract,workflow,subdomain=subdomain_add_predecessor(ROOT)")
    native=next(i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith('    native=workflow.split('))
    call=lines.index("    subdomain_add_checks(tmp,subdomain)")
    frag=lines.index("    check('Retail variants retain all189 native commands and add five exact producers',")
    return ('\n'.join(lines[:start]+lines[native:call]+lines[frag-1:])+'\n').encode()

def soup(r):return BeautifulSoup(r.text,'html.parser')
def token(r):
    n=soup(r).select_one('input[name=csrf]') or soup(r).select_one('meta[name=csrf-token]')
    if not n:raise AssertionError('No CSRF in '+r.url+' status '+str(r.status_code))
    return n.get('value',n.get('content'))
def form_data(form):
    data={}
    for n in form.select('input[name],textarea[name],select[name]'):
        if n.get('type') in ('file','submit','button'):continue
        if n.get('type') in ('checkbox','radio') and not n.has_attr('checked'):continue
        if n.name=='textarea':v=n.text
        elif n.name=='select':
            option=n.select_one('option[selected]') or n.select_one('option');v=option.get('value',option.text) if option else ''
        else:v=n.get('value','')
        data[n['name']]=v
    return data
def form_for(r,action):
    for f in soup(r).select('form'):
        a=f.select_one('input[name=action]')
        if a and a.get('value')==action:return f
    raise AssertionError('Form missing '+action+' at '+r.url)
def submit(s,url,action,overrides=None,files=None):
    r=s.get(url,timeout=15);f=form_for(r,action);data=form_data(f);data.update(overrides or {})
    return s.post(urljoin(url,f.get('action') or url),data=data,files=files,timeout=25)
